title: Net worth
subtitle: Everything you own and owe, in {{currency}}

empty.title: No net worth to show yet
empty.body: Add a bank account, property or investment, then record a snapshot, and your net worth will appear here, tracked month by month. A snapshot is the value on your statement at month-end. Record one each month.

secondary.label: Also in
secondary.noRate: ≈ — · no {{currency}} rate yet — add one in Settings to convert.

headline.stalePositions_one: ⚠ {{count}} item carried forward — record {{when}} snapshot to keep this up to date.
headline.stalePositions_other: ⚠ {{count}} items carried forward — record {{when}} snapshots to keep this up to date.
headline.unsettledTerminations_one: ⚠ {{count}} investment was closed without a sale or maturity recorded — its final value is showing as a loss.
headline.unsettledTerminations_other: ⚠ {{count}} investments were closed without a sale or maturity recorded — their final value is showing as a loss.

missingFx.line: ⚠ Net worth excludes {{subject}} — no {{when}} exchange rate for {{currencies}}. Add {{addRate}} in Settings.
missingFx.lineGroup: ⚠ This total excludes {{subject}} — no {{when}} exchange rate for {{currencies}}. Add {{addRate}} in Settings.

thisMonth.title: This month
thisMonth.baseline: First tracked month — there's no earlier month to compare against yet, so income and spending figures start the month after.

statement.assetValueChangeHint: Non-cash — depreciation or revaluation of property and vehicles. No money changed hands.
statement.writeOffsHint: Value that left your books without any money changing hands — something disposed of, a debt forgiven, or money owed to you that won't be repaid. A forgiven debt counts in your favour.
statement.trackingChangesHint: Value that came into or went out of what you track here without being earned, spent or invested — something you already owned but only started tracking now, or accounts that joined or left the household. It isn't income or spending, so it's kept out of both.
statement.livingExpensesHint: Estimated from the change in your net worth minus tracked income and investment return. This app doesn't track individual purchases.
statement.unexplainedIncreaseHint: Your net worth rose more than tracked income and investment return explain — for example an untracked gift or a revaluation.
